sessionStart.comment: Checks for ai-dev-kit plugin updates at the start of every agent session. Runs silently within a 5-second timeout so it never blocks the session from starting.

userPromptSubmitted.comment: Intercepts every prompt before execution and denies any that contain destructive SQL (DROP TABLE/SCHEMA/CATALOG/DATABASE/VIEW, TRUNCATE TABLE, DELETE FROM), dangerous shell commands (rm, rmdir, mkfs, shred, wipefs, fdisk, dd), or destructive git operations (--force push, reset --hard, clean -f). Returns {permissionDecision: deny} with a reason to block; allow otherwise.

preToolUse.comment: Intercepts every tool call before execution and denies any that contain destructive SQL (DROP TABLE/SCHEMA/CATALOG/DATABASE/VIEW, TRUNCATE TABLE, DELETE FROM), dangerous shell commands (rm, rmdir, mkfs, shred, wipefs, fdisk, dd), or destructive git operations (--force push, reset --hard, clean -f). Returns {permissionDecision: deny} with a reason to block; allow otherwise.
